required_changes_injected: Champion score regressed from 4/10 (cumulative state) to 2/10 (new analysis) without documented justification. New analysis downgrades to 2/10 citing 'no direct quote from Dani' and 'no evidence of securing stakeholder access' — but these are new evidentiary standards not applied in the prior assessment. If the standard for Champion has changed, this must be explicitly stated as a methodology shift, not presented as a regression. Additionally, the new analysis states 'the word implied was used in prior analysis — this analysis scores only what is explicitly stated' — this is a retroactive reframing of scoring criteria that contradicts the cumulative state's own language ('suggesting internal advocacy'). Recommendation: Either (1) maintain Champion at 4/10 with note 'No new information in Call 2 — Dani continues to facilitate evaluation; maintaining prior score pending title/seniority confirmation,' or (2) if downgrading to 2/10, explicitly document in the analysis that the scoring standard has been tightened and explain why prior 4/10 was incorrect. Current state violates Criterion 2 (Carry-forward consistency) by regressing without documented reason.
